_README: Verified published 10Y closes supplement lagging automated feeds.
Re-read sourceUrl each refresh and cross-check the headline with a different provider.
observations contains dated historical closes from the SAME sourceUrl as the headline.
1D uses the previous session; 1M/1Y require an observation on or before the calendar anniversary (within seven days).
When advancing a headline date, also retrieve both anniversary anchors from sourceUrl; recent-session observations alone leave 1M/1Y blank.
Monthly history is merged by date. Missing months and unsupported moves stay unavailable.
